item.title: Version 1.4.3
item.description:
Lumary Audio 1.4.3
Cleaner high notes, and clearer channels on big interfaces.
• Saturation no longer adds off-key tones to high notes. TAPE, CASSETTE, TUBE and PENTODE stay clean even on the highest notes at full DRIVE.
• CHANNEL is now IN CH, right under INPUT, and lists your interface's own names for its inputs, like Input 9 · Mic 9.
• New OUT CH picks which outputs you listen on, for interfaces with more than two. Live and tape playback both play there, so headphones on outputs 11–12 just work.
• With the source on auto, guitar notes played with vibrato are no longer mistaken for a voice.
Requires macOS 26 or later.
